_doc: Director motion data (rr-17), Storm Capacitor on the rr-05 rig pipeline. Source pixels of the 255 px painting. Key rows are [phase, value] or [phase, value, interpolation]; the interpolation names the segment that ENDS at that key, as in scripts/maquette_cutout_runtime/motion.gd: smoothstep (default), linear, or hold (the previous value holds until this key's phase, then jumps). column.glow is an integer light level for the arcs and the vent glow: -2 dead, -1 dim, 0 as painted, 1 bright, 2 flare; it only ever changes by hold keys. cap.lean_deg: positive tips the cap's top toward the facing's forward; it pivots at the dome's bottom centre. body moves the whole actor, base included.

storm_capacitor.pieces_note: base = the stone plinth with its four corner blocks; column = both glass sections with their arcs and all three copper bands, including the top band's raised end blocks (one rigid piece); cap = the dome and spike, everything above the dome's lower dark outline between the top band's end blocks. The vent fill lies under the cap on the column layer. Every piece is rigid. One view: the rear facing shows the same front rig, never mirrored.

idle.note: still, then a buzz: the cap rattles up 1 px twice (0.1 s each) while the arcs brighten one step with it; nothing else moves

charge.note: pressure builds: the arcs brighten in two steps while the cap climbs 3 px a pixel at a time; it rattles at the top through the contact (the existing charge VFX), then drops back with a 1 px bounce as the arcs settle

discharge.note: Arc Burst: two warning rattles as the arcs flare, then the cap springs up 6 px and vents the glow at the contact (the chain lightning leaves); the spent arcs drop to dim and the cap slams back down with a 1 px bounce; the arcs recover by the end

hit.note: the whole capacitor jolts 1 px back, the cap rattles twice and the arcs flash one step

death.note: a last flare blows the cap 8 px up, tipping back; it drops and lands askew (3 px up, 12 degrees back) while the arcs sputter out: dim, a flicker, dead, one weak flicker, dead; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
